artistId.title: Artist Store
artistId.description: Select a K-Pop artist store on Weverse Shop (or enter any numeric artistId).

customArtistUrl.title: Or Custom Weverse Shop URL (Optional)
customArtistUrl.description: If provided, scrapes this exact Weverse Shop artist/category URL instead of the dropdown above (e.g. https://shop.weverse.io/en/shop/USD/artists/7).

maxItems.title: Max Products to Scrape
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to extract (0 = all found on page/categories).

includeProductDetails.title: Fetch Detailed Stock & Badges
includeProductDetails.description: Visit individual product pages for exact stock status, badges, and description (slower, uses more compute).
